selection_rationale: Picked the amplifiers and system processors most often met in French rental, touring, theatre and school racks: Crown XLS and Yamaha PX for small portable PA (class D), Yamaha XMV for installed 70/100 V sound, L-Acoustics (LA4X, LA12X, LA7.16), d&b (D40, D80), NEXO (NXAMP4x4MK2) and Powersoft X8 as tour-grade DSP amplified controllers, and dbx DriveRack PA2/VENU360, Meyer GALAXY 816 and L-Acoustics P1 as loudspeaker processors. Devices go under class-d only when the manufacturer states the class and the product is mainly a power amp; the amplified controllers (several also stated class D) are filed under dsp-amplifier. No class AB or class A device was entered: no current pro-audio product page read in this session states class AB, and class A is rare in PA power amplification. Both gaps are logged in not_found_log, partly because the shared web-search budget ran out mid-task.

devices.technology: Two-channel 2U power amplifier; QSC spec sheet lists 'Output Circuitry: AB' and the user manual defines AB as 'Class AB complementary linear output'. Toroidal transformer, fan cooled.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: The RMX series was QSC's affordable 2U touring/rental amplifier line; the 850 and 1450 are the two models QSC itself documents as plain class AB (larger RMX models are class H). A good example of a linear amp with every common input and output connector.
typical_uses: installed sound in schools and venues
